directories.title: Classical Culinary Institute
directories.tagline: Brigade training from first sear to executive pass
directories.summary: The flagship school — French technique, station discipline, and the career ladder from home cook to executive chef, plus garde manger cold kitchen mastery.

directories.title: Pastry & Baking Academy
directories.summary: Dedicated baking campus — measure by weight, master fermentation, laminated dough, chocolate, and the pastry chef mindset.

directories.title: Competition & Television Studio
directories.summary: Train like the shows — quickfire timing, replication drills, brigade wars, and iron-chef style basket cooking under the clock.

directories.title: Plant-Forward & Hospitality School
directories.summary: Modern culinary education — plant-based technique without compromise, plus hospitality, hosting, and kitchen leadership for service-minded cooks.

directories.title: Global Cuisine Institute
directories.summary: Regional deep dives across Asia, Mediterranean, Latin America, Middle East, Africa, and a fusion capstone — aromatics, staples, and signature dishes per culture.

track.amateur_to_executive.title: Amateur to Executive Chef
track.amateur_to_executive.summary: Eight-level career ladder from first sear to leading a kitchen — techniques, flavors, and leadership at every station.

track.master_baker.title: Master Baker
track.master_baker.summary: Six-level baking path from first loaf to laminated pastry, chocolate work, and pastry leadership.

track.game_show.title: Game Show Kitchen
track.game_show.summary: Six competition modules inspired by Top Chef, Hell's Kitchen, MasterChef, Restaurant Wars, Iron Chef, and GBBO — speed, replication, and nerves of steel.

track.plant_forward.title: Plant-Forward Culinary Arts
track.plant_forward.summary: Four-level certificate from vegetable fundamentals to composed plant-based menus — flavor, texture, and protein without compromise.

track.garde_manger.title: Garde Manger & Charcuterie
track.garde_manger.summary: Four-level cold kitchen certificate — salads, charcuterie, preservation, and buffet platters with classical garde manger discipline.

track.hospitality.title: Hospitality & Service Leadership
track.hospitality.summary: Four-level certificate in service fundamentals, menu engineering, event hosting, and kitchen leadership for front- and back-of-house thinkers.

track.global_cuisines.title: World Cuisines Diploma
track.global_cuisines.summary: Six-level regional diploma — Asia, Mediterranean, Latin America, Middle East, Africa, and a fusion capstone with pantry-matched practice per culture.
